content.comment_body: Hello. I tested the TESTDemo21092022-1_new1, but noticed that the Time Zone field on the [product_name] Web page does not let me set negative values.

It seems this is a bug in the [product_name] firmware. If you set a negative value (e.g., -5) in the [product_name] software, the web server displays it. You can't change this to another negative value via the web interface, but you can change a negative value to a positive one (e.g., +2).
I noticed the same problem with [product_name] in a previous version; I've tested it too.

Hi. I've checked your suggestion using the [product_name] software and confirmed that it works. However, I can't expect customers in time zones like -1 or -5 to adjust settings using specialized software because a software error prevents changes from the web server. Most users aren't interested in programming, and they expect reliable and easy-to-use products. This feedback is meant to help improve the system over time rather than criticize.
I didn't make a proposal; I simply ran a test and shared the result.

Hi. I understand. When I mentioned 'proposal,' I meant your suggestion to use [product_name] software as a workaround for the [product_name] Web interface limitation, and verifying your test results. Is that correct?

I've tested this as well. The error can be reproduced, and the test results are accurate. This is just one of many bugs, and [company_name] really needs to release an update to [product_name] and its operating systems. Kind regards, [user_name]

I didn't state it like that. My point was: If someone sets a negative value for the time zone parameter in the [product_name] software diagram, the web server displays that negative value. However, changing that value to another negative one via the web server isn't possible; you can only change to positive values there. That’s what my test indicated, and I believe this is a bug in the firmware or in the [product_name] Web Editor. That's my statement.
Thanks for clarifying. I didn't intend to cause any irritation and appreciate your help. With that, I consider this discussion closed. Thank you and see you next time.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report a recurring issue where the Time Zone field on the [product_name] Web page does not permit changing to negative values directly. Although it's possible to preset a negative value using [product_name] software, switching to another negative value through the web interface does not work. This problem appears across multiple firmware versions and limits straightforward configuration by non-technical customers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to adjust negative time zone values directly from the web interface, without needing programming skills or additional software.
pain_keywords: inability to change negative time zone
